summary.zh: 为单仓搭建本地与远程构建缓存
summary.en: Set up local and remote caching for Turborepo

description.zh: 覆盖 Turborepo 任务配置、缓存键设计与远程缓存接入，帮助缩减单仓的构建与测试耗时。适合新项目初始化或流水线明显变慢时使用。远程缓存需要可用的缓存服务与相应凭据。
description.en: Configure Turborepo tasks, cache keys, and remote caching to shorten build and test time in monorepos. Remote caching needs a cache service and credentials.
